LanguageData.Rukaya_DietMeatNutrition: Nutrition from meat and mixed meals: 60%
LanguageData.Rukaya_DietInfoDescription: Rukaya thrive on vegetarian food, including milk, eggs, and fungi. Eating vegetarian meals grants a short mood boost, while going more than three days without them causes mood penalties. Meat and mixed meals provide only 60% nutrition and do not satisfy this need.
LanguageData.Rukaya_DietNeedAtMinimum: Eat vegetarian food to satisfy this need.
